```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compress logs older than 7 days and delete compressed logs older than 30 days."""
import argparse
import gzip
import shutil
import time
from pathlib import Path

COMPRESS_AFTER_DAYS = 7
DELETE_AFTER_DAYS = 30


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("directory", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("-n", "--dry-run", action="store_true",
                        help="show what would be done without changing anything")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    now = time.time()
    compressed, deleted, skipped = [], [], []

    for path in sorted(args.directory.glob("*.log*")):
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        age_days = (now - path.stat().st_mtime) / 86400

        if path.suffix == ".gz":
            if age_days > DELETE_AFTER_DAYS:
                if not args.dry_run:
                    path.unlink()
                deleted.append(path)
        elif age_days > COMPRESS_AFTER_DAYS:
            target = path.with_name(path.name + ".gz")
            if target.exists():
                skipped.append(path)
                continue
            if not args.dry_run:
                with open(path, "rb") as src, gzip.open(target, "wb") as dst:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst)
                # Keep the original mtime so the 30-day clock runs from the last log write.
                shutil.copystat(path, target)
                path.unlink()
            compressed.append(path)

    prefix = "Would have " if args.dry_run else ""
    for label, paths in (("compressed", compressed), ("deleted", deleted),
                         ("skipped (.gz already exists)", skipped)):
        print(f"{prefix}{label}: {len(paths)}")
        for p in paths:
            print(f"  {p.name}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

Run it as `python3 script.py /var/log/myapp --dry-run`. It matches `*.log*` in the top level of the directory only (so `app.log`, `app.log.1`, `app.log.gz`), and age is taken from each file's modification time, so change the glob if your logs are named differently.
